text: A consumer's equilibrium is determined by the point of tangency of the budget line and the indifference curve. Which of the following is true about the slope of the budget line?
options: The slope of the budget line is given by $P_Y/P_X$.
The slope of the budget line is given by $P_X/P_Y$.
The slope of the budget line is given by $P_X + P_Y$.
The slope of the budget line is given by $P_X - P_Y$.
explanation: The slope of the budget line is given by the price of good X divided by the price of good Y, i.e., $P_X/P_Y$. This is because the budget line is a straight line that represents all possible combinations of the two goods that a consumer can buy with a given budget.
subject: Economics

text: The law of equi-marginal utility states that a consumer will allocate his income in such a way that the marginal utility of each good is equal. Which of the following is a consequence of this law?
options: A consumer will always buy more of the good with higher price.
A consumer will always buy more of the good with lower price.
A consumer will allocate his income in such a way that the marginal utility of each good is equal.
A consumer will always buy the same quantity of both goods.
explanation: The law of equi-marginal utility states that a consumer will allocate his income in such a way that the marginal utility of each good is equal. This means that the consumer will buy more of the good that gives him higher marginal utility per unit of money spent.
subject: Economics

text: The indifference map is a graphical representation of the various combinations of two goods that a consumer is indifferent between. Which of the following is a characteristic of the indifference map?
options: The indifference map is a straight line.
The indifference map is a curve.
The indifference map is a circle.
The indifference map is a rectangle.
explanation: The indifference map is a graphical representation of the various combinations of two goods that a consumer is indifferent between. It is a curve because the consumer is indifferent between different combinations of the two goods.
subject: Economics

text: The price elasticity of demand is a measure of how responsive the quantity demanded of a good is to a change in its price. Which of the following is the formula for price elasticity of demand?
options: Percentage change in quantity demanded divided by percentage change in price.
Percentage change in price divided by percentage change in quantity demanded.
Percentage change in quantity demanded divided by percentage change in price plus one.
Percentage change in price divided by percentage change in quantity demanded plus one.
explanation: The price elasticity of demand is a measure of how responsive the quantity demanded of a good is to a change in its price. The formula for price elasticity of demand is the percentage change in quantity demanded divided by the percentage change in price.
subject: Economics

text: The cross demand for a good is the demand for that good that is derived from the demand for another good. Which of the following is an example of cross demand?
options: The demand for coffee and tea is an example of cross demand.
The demand for coffee and sugar is an example of cross demand.
The demand for coffee and milk is an example of cross demand.
The demand for coffee and bread is an example of cross demand.
explanation: The cross demand for a good is the demand for that good that is derived from the demand for another good. An example of cross demand is the demand for coffee and tea, because the demand for coffee is affected by the demand for tea.
subject: Economics

text: The budget line is a graphical representation of the various combinations of two goods that a consumer can buy with a given budget. Which of the following is a characteristic of the budget line?
options: The budget line is a straight line.
The budget line is a curve.
The budget line is a circle.
The budget line is a rectangle.
explanation: The budget line is a graphical representation of the various combinations of two goods that a consumer can buy with a given budget. It is a straight line because the consumer can buy any combination of the two goods that lies on the line.
subject: Economics

text: The law of diminishing marginal utility states that as the consumption of a good increases, the marginal utility derived from each additional unit of the good decreases. Which of the following is a consequence of this law?
options: A consumer will always buy more of the good with higher price.
A consumer will always buy more of the good with lower price.
A consumer will allocate his income in such a way that the marginal utility of each good is equal.
A consumer will always buy the same quantity of both goods.
explanation: The law of diminishing marginal utility states that as the consumption of a good increases, the marginal utility derived from each additional unit of the good decreases. This means that a consumer will always buy more of the good with lower price.
subject: Economics

text: The indifference curve is a graphical representation of the various combinations of two goods that a consumer is indifferent between. Which of the following is a characteristic of the indifference curve?
options: The indifference curve is a straight line.
The indifference curve is a curve.
The indifference curve is a circle.
The indifference curve is a rectangle.
explanation: The indifference curve is a graphical representation of the various combinations of two goods that a consumer is indifferent between. It is a curve because the consumer is indifferent between different combinations of the two goods.

text: The consumer's equilibrium is the point on the budget line where the consumer is indifferent between the two goods. Which of the following is a characteristic of the consumer's equilibrium?
options: The consumer's equilibrium is the point on the budget line where the consumer is indifferent between the two goods.
The consumer's equilibrium is the point on the budget line where the consumer is maximizing his utility.
The consumer's equilibrium is the point on the budget line where the consumer is minimizing his cost.
The consumer's equilibrium is the point on the budget line where the consumer is maximizing his income.
explanation: The consumer's equilibrium is the point on the budget line where the consumer is indifferent between the two goods. This is because the consumer is allocating his income in such a way that the marginal utility of each good is equal.
